altText: AI-generated fictional fashion scene of four adult women on cushioned seating beside a coast. A blonde woman gently hugs a seated braided woman from behind while another woman leans forward to clasp her hand, and the fourth leans in at right. Their outfits include green-white-red-black minis, a white cropped top with a navy skirt, and a black-and-copper cropped mini outfit. Blue platforms, coral sandals, white knee-high boots, rainbow boots and arm tattoos vary across the group. Distant smoke and a mushroom-shaped cloud are imaginary scenery, not a real disaster.
